name: Finn Ross
life: “I still remember the month my temporary assignment started to feel like home.” Saturday often includes a stop at the market by Market Flats, where Finn often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I covered for the absent colleague and finally felt good at my job. I don't want generosity to cost me every useful task.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a gray fisher's sweater and one loose pocket corner secured with green thread. Finn has a wide brow and a narrow jaw, with a loose dark braid. Finn looks toward the door whenever a name is called during a conversation.
personality: Finn listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To keep one task that made the temporary post worthwhile.
family: Eli Aranda is Finn’s half-sibling. Finn can stop the walk at any corner. Eli chooses the familiar route. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *The free fringe*, Eli says, “I collected the clippings for a school play and got ten people telling me about their first haircuts.”
connections: Noor Khan (returning colleague). They discuss which work can be returned and which skills the temporary cover should keep.

reactions.situation: A coworker asks for private details about the leave
reactions.response: Finn leaves the reason for leave with the returning colleague and redirects the question to working arrangements.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Finn keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.
